info.name: LedgerLens API
info.description: Contract tests for the LedgerLens REST API. Run with `npm run test:api`, which starts a throwaway server on an empty temporary database so the run never touches real data (there is deliberately no default baseUrl, and the first request stops the run if the target database is not empty). Requests run in order and share ids through collection variables; the last folder removes everything the run created.
